remarks: Welcome to 52 Pemberwick Rd, a 2-family property perfect for investors, multi-generational households, or those seeking to offset expenses with rental income, this home offers flexibility and long-term value. Unit 1 features 3-bedrooms, 1-bath, hardwood floors, an eat-in kitchen, family room, and in-unit w/d. Currently rented month to month @ $3,300. Tenant will be given 60 days to vacate from closing date at current rent but would prefer to stay if possible. Unit 2 has 2-bedrooms, 1-bath, kitchen/dining area, family room, and w/d. Four parking spaces, a shared backyard, and a location just steps from Pemberwick Park, residents enjoy both convenience and community. Greenwich is known for its excellent schools, vibrant town center, easy access to I-95 and the Merritt Parkway, and express Metro-North trains to Manhattan. Parks, beaches, and a strong rental market make Greenwich especially appealing to both tenants and long-term investors.
